## Turn a creative brief into scene operations

The assistant inspects your scene, builds objects, edits materials, finds assets and carries out multi-step workflows with a visual chat workspace and a built-in Model Context Protocol server. ## Install

1. Download the Windows x64 installer from the latest release.
2. Run the installer and enable the add-on in Blender.
